name: Inagawa de Ikou!!
source: An amusement CD collection with characters and stuff from Comic Party and White Album. The game Night Writer is also included with this CD. Night Writer is mainly a typing game featuring Corin. You battle demons from Dr^2 Night Janki by typing words for your attacks.
translation: 一张娱乐CD合集，收录《漫画同人会》《白色相簿》的角色与相关内容。CD中也包含《Night Writer》：这是一款以柯琳为主角的打字游戏。玩家通过输入词语发动攻击，对抗《Dr² Night Janki》中的恶魔。
